#13 I believe that there was a systematic mistake with the indexing in this section. In a number of places, there were mislabelings of “I” by “A”. In particular, one should not write “i \in A”, since I and A are completely unrelated indexing sets. This amends the final proof and replaces each inappropriate instance of A by I.

Steven C.
